note: Village of Cody municipal park; small grassy camping area near the old grain elevator (shields US-20 noise), behind the C-store a block off the highway. Directory reports (Campendium, Allstays, a 2023 blog): ~4-10 unmarked full-hookup back-in sites (30/50 A, water, sewer) beside pedestals, dump station, max RV ~29 ft, restrooms not always open, $20 a night honor system (cash/check), FCFS, open ~May 1-Oct 15. The village has no website (the old villageofcody.com domain now forwards to an unrelated site); call the village clerk. --Claude
